guidance.heading: Business Outlook
section: Intel's guidance for the fourth quarter of 2026 includes both GAAP and non-GAAP estimates as follows:

Q4 2026 | GAAP | Non-GAAP
Revenue ($B) | $15.0 - $16.0
Gross margin | 37.1% | 38.0%
Tax Rate | 31% | 11%
Earnings (Loss) Per Share Attributable to Intel—Diluted | $0.10 | $0.25
